title: Task node (DAG vertex) contract
description: One node of the emitted task DAG. Nodes are atomic research tasks: exactly one accountable primary skill, at most one collaborator, a verifiable definition of done, explicit failure semantics, and a cost budget.

id.description: Stable node id; kebab-case recommended. Referenced by depends_on and by replan triggers.

collaborator_skill.description: At most one supporting skill. More than one means the node must be split.

inputs.description: Producer references: '<node_id>:<artifact>' for upstream outputs, or 'request'/'context'/'constraints'/'evidence_refs:<id>'/'data_refs:<id>' for external inputs. Anything else is an implicit dependency and fails self-audit gate G1.

outputs.description: Artifact names this node produces, referenceable downstream as '<this id>:<artifact>'.

depends_on.description: Ids of nodes that must complete first. Must be consistent with inputs: if an input names '<node>:<artifact>', that node must be (transitively) upstream.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must hold at execution start, beyond dependency completion (e.g. 'instrument X calibrated').

unit.description: Units are mandatory for physical quantities; unit mismatches raise E_UNIT_INCONSISTENT at audit time.

human_approval_gate.description: True when this node may modify data, write long-term knowledge, run real (wet-lab) experiments, operate hazardous materials, or execute high-risk external commands. Such nodes require controller-mediated human approval before execution; the planner marks them but never approves them.

optional.description: True = node belongs to an optional path; plan must still close without it.

on_failure_replan.description: Node ids of declared recovery/fallback tasks activated if this node exhausts retries.

tool_permissions.description: Least-privilege tool permissions the executing skill will need. 'network', 'execute_commands', 'lab_instruments' and 'long_term_memory_write' imply human_approval_gate=true when risk_level is high.
